text: Did the vendor send the revised contract this morning? They did, and the payment terms finally match what we asked for. Net forty five? Net forty five, with the early payment discount intact. Good. Legal still needs to check the liability clause. I flagged it. Okay. Their limit is capped at the annual fee, which our counsel wanted doubled. If they refuse the doubling, we should ask for a longer cure period instead. That is a sensible fallback. Yes. I will draft both options and send them before the call on Wednesday. Please copy the finance team when you do. Will do. Anything else pending from their side? Just the insurance certificate, promised by Friday.
